title: THE CLOUD REVIEW: FIRES, CRATES, BOUNTY, CONVOY, KEYS
why: The cloud review of 2026-10-15, each finding checked against the code first. 3: pillagers and machines chasing the player across a fire stood grinding on its edge and burning; they now slide round the edge the short way, and no event, fire or ambush is placed in a stronghold. 10: the convoy crew and the bounty pillager were taken out of the world in plain view when their event ended; a body now leaves only where nobody can see it, otherwise it stays as an ordinary enemy and the callout says so. 12: the 6 CRATES run goal counted boxes that pillagers and hires had emptied; it counts what the party opens, player 2 included, never bodies. 17: the bounty was paid for a down and for deaths nobody caused; now only a kill by the party pays and a downed hunter is still on the hunt. 21: the air strike prompts named the keyboard key G whatever it was bound to; they name the bound key.
now: Fires, crates, the bounty, the convoy and the strike key are cleaned up.
